answers.core: It's tiny, and its sole purpose is to support an add-on so I think it's an appropriate thing to add into core.
answers.workaround: It could theoretically be worked around with an audio stream generator and sufficiently advanced plugin wrangling, but it really wouldn't be the kind of drop-in experience that I think users want.
